title: Composition builds from parts
summary: Composition gives an object another object to use. A bike has a bell; a bike is not a kind of bell.
introduction: Composition gives an object another object to use. A bike has a bell; a bike is not a kind of bell. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Composition gives an object another object to use. A bike has a bell; a bike is not a kind of bell.

blocks.title: Composition builds from parts

blocks.text: The result is ding. The bike asks its bell to do one job.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Replace the bell with one that returns ring-ring.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not make Bike extend Bell just to borrow ring.
For more detail later, use this [Object-Oriented Programming further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Advanced_JavaScript_objects).
